_intro: - 47 tools; 39 licensed on the surveyed machine. The 8 ANZ Toolbox tools (Convert To MText, Explode Text, Find and Replace, Alignment/Excel/Legend Table, Create Slope Markers) need ANZToolbox. Check yours with `tbc_license`.
- No tool acts immediately: each opens a panel, a dialog or a separate editor first. Print commands only print after you press Print in Windows' Print dialog; never press it unless the user asks.
- **Line Type Editor and Symbol Editor start a separate program (PEDITOR.exe)** with its own window. Close it when done (its window's X / CloseMainWindow).
- Just opening **Dimension Style Manager** and cancelling marked the project as modified (TBC adds default style data).
- Prerequisites shown as popups: Edit Text needs exactly one text object selected; Custom Sheet needs a custom sheet set selected; Print Plan Set needs a plan set with sheets.
EditText: needs one text object selected ('Select one text object.')
CreateCustomSheet: needs a custom sheet set selected first
PrintPlanSet: needs a plan set with sheets ('No plan set was found ...')
DraftingTemplates: no panel appeared with nothing selected
DimensionStyleManager: opening it marks the project modified
PurgeBlocks: Apply deletes the checked unused block definitions
PrintPlanView: panel creates a plotbox; printing happens only from Windows' Print dialog
PrintBySelection: printing happens only from Windows' Print dialog
